name: Perhexiline

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in United Kingdom and Spain, first in 1985 — for liver harm and nerve and brain harm

examples.title: Open-Label Study of Perhexiline in Patients With Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy and Moderate to Severe Heart Failure

summary: Perhexiline was removed from the market in the United Kingdom and Spain starting in 1985 because it caused damage to the liver, nerves, and brain [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on people, calculated low risk scores of 36 for the liver and 33 for the heart [M]. Additionally, a study testing the drug on patients with heart conditions was stopped because it did not work [5].
